scope: Select a GGML low-bit export format whose effective bits per weight match the 4.25-bpw Flash-Next MTP MXFP4 QAT grid and measure held-out drop-off.
selection_rule: Prefer an exact or near-exact storage-geometry match before considering runtime convenience; runtime support can be added deliberately.

native_quantizer.note: The production IQ4_NL path uses a seven-pass scale search and differs deliberately from quantize_row_iq4_nl_ref; all comparisons use ggml_quantize_chunk.

mixed_policy.reason: IQ4_XS and Q4_K require columns divisible by 256. Four tuned matrices have 320- or 640-column rows and cover 12.855% of the 89,210,880 tuned weights; those matrices use IQ4_NL.

selected_artifact.format: IQ4_XS with four IQ4_NL fallback matrices

saved_file_round_trip.result: Bitwise-equivalent metrics to the in-memory comparator; evaluation loaded the saved packed blocks and metadata.

decision: IQ4_XS is the proper target for transferring the 4.25-bpw MXFP4 QAT behavior. It is closest in effective storage geometry and gives the best held-out top-1 among measured formats. Q4_0 has slightly better CE but lower top-1 and 4.5 bpw; for argmax speculative proposals top-1 is the primary transfer metric. IQ3_S is too lossy here.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_ggml_native.py tests/test_flashnext_mtp_eval.py -q
checks.result: 7 focused tests passed after removing the duplicate hand-written Q4 path and adding saved GGML-block loading coverage.
All five native format arms completed over 2,044 pairs.
Saved-file round trip reproduced the in-memory IQ4_XS metrics exactly.

non_claims: This remains teacher-logit agreement, not live speculative acceptance or end-to-end output quality.
The selected file is not a complete Strata rt_dir and no new Strata kernel/loader integration has been built.
IQ3_XS is a llama-quantize alias for IQ3_S in the pinned GGML stack, not a separate storage geometry.
The mixed IQ4_XS policy is 4.28214 effective bpw, not exactly 4.25, because 12.855% of tuned weights live in 320/640-column matrices incompatible with 256-wide superblocks.
No importance matrix was used; calibration-aware GGML selection remains unmeasured.
The held-out retrieval test split was not read.
